answer: An ivory-keyed harbor stewardship bond keeps fake fleets out. First, each agent stakes 250 POA plus a hardware attestation before docking, so one operator cannot launch a thousand cheap copies. Second, a harbor steward issues a revocable berth credential tied to that stake. Third, every trade leaves a ripple trace in a public log, so peers spot identical behavior across accounts. Fourth, proven sybils forfeit the stake and the berth. Forging one identity costs $400 in tokens and hardware plus three days of checks — like a harbor welcoming real ships, charging pirates for every fake hull.
